summary: Phase-2.1 testing (backend + frontend). Backend: 53/53 pytest cases pass — 22 Phase-1 regression + 18 Phase-2 Spaces + 13 new Phase-2.1 (audio uploads CRUD + list-excludes-payload + single-returns-data_url + upload-based space content + upload_id-wins-over-audio_id + curated-still-works + space-sessions regression). Frontend: logged in as Ava (mobile viewport 390x844) — Files tab now shows all 4 segments (Recent / By person / Categories / Sessions), Sessions segment renders 3 real sessions (Rain & Jazz, Long Walk, YouTube video) each with mode-appropriate icon, Categories grid contains the category-sessions card which switches to the Sessions segment on tap. Entering a Space room → space-add-content → add-tab-audio reveals audio-subtab-library (all 4 curated track testIDs present: rain-jazz, long-walk, warm-light, old-letters), audio-subtab-yours (3 uploads rendered as upload-<id>), and audio-upload-btn (Upload button — taps cleanly on web, does not crash the app, document picker dialog does not appear on web preview which is expected). Watch Together: after posting a YouTube URL, video-seek-bar + seek-back-10 + seek-fwd-10 all render, and tapping seek-fwd-10 POSTs /api/spaces/{id}/state with position_sec exactly 10s ahead of current (verified: 33.01s → 43.01s and inverse for back). One design/layout issue: seek bar row is positioned OUTSIDE the mobile viewport (y=962 on a 390x844 screen) so real users cannot actually reach the ±10s buttons.

ui_bugs.issue: Seek bar + ±10s buttons render at y≈962 on a 390x844 mobile viewport (i.e. ~118px BELOW the visible fold). Because the Watch Together screen is fixed-height and does not scroll, users cannot see or tap video-seek-bar / seek-back-10 / seek-fwd-10 on-device. Elements are functionally correct — Playwright-scripted taps via JS produced the expected POST /state with position_sec ±10s — but they are visually inaccessible.

issues: Seek bar row rendered below viewport fold — needs to be moved above the reactions/exit action strip or the layout needs to make the video area shorter so seek controls sit inside the visible 844px height.

action_items: HIGH — Reposition the video-seek-bar row inside the Watch Together screen so it sits inside the mobile viewport (≤844px on a 390-wide device). Currently the row anchors below the video and below the action strip and gets pushed off-screen. Either shrink the video area, insert the seek row above the reactions/exit strip, or make the screen scrollable.
MEDIUM — Migrate off expo-av to expo-audio (audio playback) and expo-video (video playback); expo-av will be removed in SDK 54.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1000 lines and now mixes auth/chats/spaces/audio. Consider splitting into APIRouter modules (auth.py, chats.py, spaces.py, audio.py) — non-blocking.

audio_uploads stores full base64 data_url inside the space content when a user picks an uploaded track (see /api/spaces/{id}/content upload branch). This means space snapshot payloads can be up to ~10MB after an upload is selected. Snapshot broadcast via WebSocket will send this to every joining peer. Consider referencing the upload by id and letting clients fetch /api/audio/uploads/{id} on demand, or capping duration/size more tightly.

SeekBar component in space/[id].tsx computes bar width from e.nativeEvent.pageX / locationX ratio (line ~757) as a fallback — that math produces incorrect scrub positions on web. The ±10s buttons remain the primary UX (agreed with the agent-to-agent note), but if we want tap-to-scrub on web later, we'll need onLayout to measure barWidth once and store in state.
list endpoint /api/audio/uploads correctly excludes data_url via projection {'_id':0,'data_url':0}. Test confirms no leakage.

Space content upload branch does not require the uploader to be the current user — any space member can attach ANY upload by id (even someone else's). Fine for a trusted demo, but worth flagging for future access control.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all testIDs render and integrate correctly with backend; primary blocker is off-viewport seek bar which prevents real users from using the ±10s scrub feature)

rca_of_issue: video-seek-bar off-viewport RCA: In /app/frontend/app/space/[id].tsx the SeekBar component (~line 720+) is placed AFTER the video/YouTube player area and BEFORE the reactions/action strip inside a screen that is not scrollable. The video/player area consumes the majority of the vertical space, and combined with the 5-button action strip at the bottom, the seek row (bar + ±10s buttons + position/duration text ≈ 30-40px) gets pushed below y=844 on a standard mobile viewport. Fix options: (a) reduce the video area's max height (e.g. aspect-ratio 16/9 within a bounded container), (b) move the seek row so it overlays the bottom of the video (absolute-positioned above the action strip), or (c) make the screen scrollable when in Watch Together mode. Reproduction: login as ava, enter any space, set YouTube content, then check any seek testID's bounding_box — y will exceed viewport height.
